about.title: Meet Jamie Parke
paragraphs: Jamie Parke learned the trade from his dad, Jerry, and worked at The Dalles Auto Sales and Point S Tires before opening his own shop on East 2nd Street, across from Big Jim's.
His approach to diagnosis is simple: scanners and listening. Most cars are diagnosed within a day or two.

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and Jamie will get back to you. Or call (541) 980-7560 (Mon–Fri: 8am–5pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Jamie will get back to you soon to set up a time.
